programmes.d: Although not a professional chef, Challenger Tatsuo Umemiya knows his cooking.
Iron Chef Sakai does battle with Seiya Kawasaki, a master of wild game cooking styles.
Iron Chef Chen looks worried when Challenger Toshikatsu Nakagawa comes to Kitchen stadium.
Furusho Hiroshi comes to Iron Chef town for turkey trouble with Iron Chef Michiba.
Will Iron Chef Sakai, who is weak against female competitors, prevail against Masayo Waki?
How will Challenger Toshiyuki Nakagawa try to use mochi against Iron Chef Chen?
Challenger Kouji Yamada left the prestigious Tokyo University for a life as a chef.
Hisao Odachi comes to Kitchen Stadium and must make dishes in his showdown with Iron Chef Chen.
Fuyuko Kondo, the 4th female challenger, takes on Iron Chef Sakai.
Kandagawa brings another female challenger, Yoshie Tobe, into the ring against Iron Chef Chen.
Masuo Suzuki comes into Kitchen Stadium to issue a Matsuba crab challenge to Iron Chef Michiba.
Iron Chef Chen takes on Challenger Kunihiko Hashimoto, an authority on Japanese cuisine.
Sakai faces a challenger known as Mr. Gourmet. Komine is a world-class vegetable chef.
Zeityen Wan hopes to make magic with his noodle dishes in just one hour.
The first pizza expert to enter Kitchen Stadium tries to create a pizza with squid.
Shigeo Yuasa is the head chef of the Okayama International Hotel.
Challenger Chiyo Cho has the support from the people of Kobe as he challenges Iron Chef Chen.
Challenger Kunio Santo battles it out with Iron Chef Sakai in the battle of clam.
Keisuke Tamano challenges Michiba to an ultimate grudge battle.
Chairman Kaga welcomes Korean cuisine for the first time to Kitchen Stadium.
Isao Yanagidate opens the door to a long-term battle between Club Mistral and Club des Trentes.
Challenger Etsuo Joh takes on the Iron Chef Japanese, Rokusaburo Michiba.
Chairman Kaga invites the very first diner cook to compete at Kitchen Stadium.
Dissatisfied with the results of their last encounter, Club Mistral is back for a rematch.
In this battle of blue crab, Challenger Akaboshi Sou takes on Iron Chef Michiba.
Three years after losing to Iron Chef Chen, the Italian restaurant Sabatini demands a rematch.
In the battle of sole at Kitchen stadium, Iron Chef Sakai faces off against Chef Takayoshi Kawai.
Returning to Kitchen Stadium is the prestigious and young Japanese chef Haruyoshi Omino.
